name: Rolziracetam
summary: Rolziracetam is a nootropic drug of the racetam family.

uses.text: It has a wide margin of safety in animals and has been evaluated for use in cognitively impaired human subjects.

fact.en: Rolziracetam has the 2-pyrrolidinone ring that every racetam shares, here fused into a second ring rather than carrying a side chain.
fact.zh: Rolziracetam 具有所有 racetam 共有的 2-吡咯啶酮環，但這裡是與第二個環融合，而不是帶一條側鏈。
fact.zhHans: Rolziracetam 具有所有 racetam 共有的 2-吡咯啶酮环，但这里是与第二个环融合，而不是带一条侧链。
